data.title: Volta by Damac
data.about:
Discover the epitome of luxury at Volta Apartments by Damac, situated on the dynamic Sheikh Zayed Road in Downtown Dubai. Crafted by the prestigious Damac Properties, this 60-storey residential tower brings to life one to four-bedroom apartments set amidst world-class amenities that span from a semi-detached podium to a lavish rooftop, offering an experience of unparalleled comfort and grandeur. 

Levels two to fifty showcase luxury one and two-bedroom Damac Volta apartments for sale, while the pinnacle of sophistication awaits in the three and four-bedroom residences from levels fifty-one to sixty. Embrace an extraordinary lifestyle at Volta by Damac at Downtown, where every detail is crafted for excellence, and every day promises a living experience steeped in luxury and well-being.

location_tile.title: The Highway To The Future
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated on the iconic Sheikh Zayed Road, the central artery of Dubai, Damac Volta enjoys a vantage point that offers connectivity like no other. This prestigious location not only places you at the crossroads of the vibrant, bustling heart of a city synonymous with luxury and innovation but also ensures seamless access to a myriad of world-class facilities and amenities, an embodiment of modern urban living at its finest.

  • Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall: 05 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport: 15 minutes
  • Mall of the Emirates:  15 minutes
  • Dubai Marina: 20 minutes
  • Palm Jumeirah:  20 minutes
